Name: Cenoon Gacha Pony Set
Author: Cenooooon
Description:
🦄 Unique Gacha Ponies: Ultimate Collectible Companions!
Are you ready to bring some magical charm to your Stardew Valley farmhouse? Move over traditional decor—there is a new herd in town! This mod introduces a dynamic, highly randomized [b]Pony Collection System[/b] designed for true collectors and mystery-box lovers.
Turn your hard-earned gold into absolute cuteness and start building your ultimate stable today!
[heading]✨ Key Features[/heading]
1. Infinite Variety – No Two Ponies Are Alike!
The heart of this mod lies in its [b]unmatched customization algorithm[/b]. While there are multiple base pony styles, the combinations are endless:
[list]
[*]🎨 [b]Vibrant Colors:[/b] From soft, magical pastels to bold, majestic coat and mane colors.[/*]
[*]📐 [b]Diverse Shapes:[/b] Multiple body shapes, sizes, and adorable facial expressions.[/*]
[*]🎀 [b]Cute Accessories:[/b] Each pony is randomly styled with unique accessories (hats, bows, horseshoes, and more!).[/*]
[/list][quote]💡 [b]The Ultimate Collectible:[/b] Thanks to the smart randomization system, [b]no two ponies will ever look the same![/b] Every single unboxing guarantees a 100% unique "one-of-a-kind" masterpiece. The pure anticipation and hype of seeing what your next pony looks like will keep you hooked and excited every single time![/quote]2. Get Your Mystery Boxes at The Stardrop Saloon
No need to grind deep in dangerous mines or wait for rare yearly festivals. You can test your luck by purchasing a [b]Pony Mystery Box[/b] directly from Gus at [b]The Stardrop Saloon[/b].
[list]
[*]💰 [b]Price:[/b]
[code]50,000g[/code]per box. [i](The perfect late-game gold sink for wealthy farmers looking to complete a luxury, high-end collection!)[/i][/*]
[/list]3. Dual Language Support (Localization)
The mod comes fully localized out of the box:
[list]
[*]🇬🇧 [b]English:[/b] Default language.[/*]
[*]🇻🇳 [b]Vietnamese:[/b] Fully translated with natural phrasing for the Vietnamese community.[/*]
[/list][heading]🛠 Requirements & Installation[/heading]
To run this mod smoothly without any issues, you will need the standard Stardew Valley modding tool:
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] (Stardew Modding API) – Latest version required.[/*]
[/list]💻 Quick Installation Guide:
[list=1]
[*]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Extract this mod's folder and drop it directly into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI, head over to the Saloon, and start unboxing your new favorite companions![/*]
[/list][i]Whether you want to line your bedroom shelves or create a dedicated pony showroom, the hunt for the perfect magical companion starts now! Got feedback or bug reports? Leave a comment below. Happy collecting![/i] 🎉
